entities.name: Dan Gîrleanu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dan Gîrleanu is a retired Romanian volleyball player who won a bronze medal at the 1980 Summer Olympics. At the club level, he played for Dinamo București, winning the 1979 CEV Cup, the 1981 CEV Champions League, and seven national titles.
